caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, brownish-copper metal pot with a lid. The pot is round with a wider body that tapers slightly towards the base and the top. The lid fits snugly onto the opening and has a flat top with a raised, rounded handle in the center. On each side of the pot, there is a curved metal handle attached to flat plates secured with rivet-like details, indicating where the handles are fastened. The surface of the pot displays a number of lighter and greenish patches, suggestive of oxidation or natural wear. The pot is set against a light, off-white or cream background, which is plain and contains no additional objects or decorations. The drawing is signed "EDWARD T. JEWETT" in small capital letters near the lower right side.
title: Copper Cauldron
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
